description.value: Chef on the Run is a family-run gourmet takeout business in the heart of Sidney that has operated since 1997, offering rotating weekly menus of fresh ready-to-heat entrées alongside frozen take 'n' bake pies and pasta dishes. Their in-store deli serves made-to-order sandwiches and homemade soups, and the shop stocks a selection of imported English groceries for a taste of British pantry staples. Touring cyclists could stop here for a hot meal, a hearty soup, or unique specialty provisions not found in a typical grocery store.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 76m; rack (5 spaces) at 80m. Total: 13 spaces.
